subject: Vendr portal onboarding jumpstart — profile ownership, evidence sprint, SFTP→service-account handoff
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Elise Martin <elise.martin@bluecrest.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Vendr portal onboarding jumpstart — profile ownership, evidence sprint, SFTP→service-account handoff

Hi Elise,

Thanks for agreeing to kick off Vendr access for BlueCrest. Per our intake, we want to run a short, focused "jumpstart" so we can: 1) confirm profile owners for SIG/CAIQ controls, 2) stage initial evidence into Vendr, and 3) transition from temporary SFTP upload to a dedicated service account for ongoing sync.

Proposed plan (30–45 min):
- 15 min: Introductions + confirm who at BlueCrest will own each profile/section (person + backup)
- 10 min: Walk through evidence manifest types we accept (S3 presigned, PDFs, system logs, screenshots)
- 10–20 min: Agree short timeline & creds handoff approach (temp SFTP TTL, then provisioned service account with key rotation cadence)

Can you confirm a 30–45 min slot tomorrow (Wed) between 10:00–13:00 PT or Thursday morning? I attached a lightweight onboarding checklist that outlines the artifacts we typically need to complete a first-pass CAIQ/SIG import.

Also looping Marissa (security intake) and Ben (portal ops) — they will lead the evidence triage during the call.

Attachments: vendr_onboarding-checklist.xlsx (checklist + sample manifest)

Cheers,
Jonas Weber
Head, Platform Partnerships
Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0142

From: Elise Martin <elise.martin@bluecrest.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: security_ops@bluecrest.com
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 10:03:12 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendr portal onboarding jumpstart — profile ownership, evidence sprint, SFTP→service-account handoff

Jonas — thanks for the clear plan. We can do Wednesday 11:30 PT. I'll be on the call with Mark Allen from our security ops team (security_ops@bluecrest.com).

Quick notes before the call so we don't waste time:
- I just invited jonas.weber@redwood.ai and marissa_cole@redwood.ai to our Vendr tenant as Admins; you should have an email invite live now (DocuSign-style admin invite id: DocuSign:0xA7B3-Vendr-Admin-Invite).
- I attached our initial evidence manifest (bluecrest_evidence_manifest_v1.json). It's a trimmed export: SOC2 reports, a handful of syslog snippets, and S3 presigned links to architecture diagrams.
- Prefer SFTP temp uploads for the jumpstart (we have an SFTP gate that will accept uploads and hand them to our ingestion queue). After the sprint we'll create a scoped service account for your ingestion and schedule a key rotation (our ops standard).

For the mapping: Mark will identify control owners during the call; we generally keep a single owner + backup per control.

See you Wednesday 11:30 PT — sending calendar invite now.

—Elise Martin
Security Program Manager, BlueCrest Financial
elise.martin@bluecrest.com | +1 617-555-0821
Attachment: bluecrest_evidence_manifest_v1.json (manifest of initial artifacts)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elise Martin <elise.martin@bluecrest.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 08:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendr portal onboarding jumpstart — profile ownership, evidence sprint, SFTP→service-account handoff

Thanks Jonas / Elise — confirmed for 11:30 PT today. Pre-call notes from our side:
- Ben and I will bring a CAIQ→SIG control mapping template so we can assign owners live. I attached the template we plan to use (sig-caiq-owner-map.csv) — lightweight: control id, proposed owner, backup, evidence type, evidence location.
- For the temporary upload: can we ask BlueCrest to create an SFTP account with a 48‑hour TTL and whitelist our ingestion IP (listed in the onboarding checklist)? That lets us pull everything into Vendr quickly and then we can validate links.
- If S3 presigned links are included we will validate expiry windows; please push longer-lived presigned URLs where possible so we don't hit 403s during triage.
- Output from the session: a short action log with 3 items: ownership roster + evidence gaps + schedule to provision the permanent service account. I will own the action log and share it after the call.

Attachments: sig-caiq-owner-map.csv (template)

Marissa Cole
Security Intake Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Elise Martin <elise.martin@bluecrest.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: security_ops@bluecrest.com
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 14:38:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendr portal onboarding jumpstart — profile ownership, evidence sprint, SFTP→service-account handoff

Great session today — appreciate the fast turnaround, Elise and Mark. Summary / next steps (action log):
1) Ownership roster: Mark provided owners for the top 60 SIG controls; Marissa will publish the completed CSV to the drive link and tag owners for handoff. (owner roster: uploaded — https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-drive-id-onboarding-guide)
2) Evidence transfer: BlueCrest uploaded a temp SFTP bundle earlier today. Ben verified manifest integrity and imported PDFs + diagrams into a staging bucket. We flagged six items with expired presigned URLs — Elise to reissue those links by EOD tomorrow.
3) Service account: BlueCrest to provision a scoped service account with read-only access to the onboarding S3 prefix; ops@bluecrest to send the key via the secure channel. We'll coordinate a rotation schedule (30 days).
4) SIG/CAIQ mapping: Marissa will run a quick pass to align controls to the Redwood verification checklist and surface any missing artifacts by Friday 12/04.

Attachments referenced: vendr_onboarding-checklist.xlsx, sig-caiq-owner-map.csv (finalizing), bluecrest_evidence_manifest_v1.json

If there are any blockers I should escalate with your legal/security teams, flag them here and I'll loop in our compliance SME. Otherwise I'll close out the action log once Marissa posts the owner CSV.

Thanks again — Jonas
Jonas Weber
Head, Platform Partnerships
Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0142
